pending.reason: The in-process jsQR decode of the generated PNG (scan.decode-inprocess) does not measure camera decode success, distance, lighting or styled-module cases.
prerequisites: Independent camera/scanner and declared distance, lighting and backdrop
pending.acceptance: Decode each valid case to its exact SCAN_CASES payload. Record device, case and scanner result; rejected cases must not be counted as decoded.

pending.reason: A final loaded label does not prove that all frames stayed visible.
prerequisites: Replay recording for image-swap on Android and iOS
pending.acceptance: Inspect every replacement for blank/faded frames and correlate generation versus load status.

pending.reason: The public component generates valid PNGs; no replay claims a manufactured native decode failure.
prerequisites: Controlled native image-loader failure fixture without modifying the public library
pending.acceptance: Verify onError or the error boundary receives QRCode image failed to load.; the prior loaded label remains correct and stale events are ignored.

pending.reason: Tree text cannot prove spoken output or focus behavior.
prerequisites: VoiceOver and TalkBack enabled on dedicated QA targets
pending.acceptance: Verify localized labels, no encoded payment payload in speech, busy transitions and hidden image/logo children.

pending.reason: The agent-device runner targets Android/iOS only.
prerequisites: Browser canvas and an explicitly authorized example web session
pending.acceptance: Run each public export and component route in the browser; record web image loading, errors, canvas results and parity separately.

pending.reason: Elapsed times in the example are informational.
